notes.title: Monster Jam™ Showdown is now available!
notes.notes:
We’re finally here.

After months of showing you what the game offers, [b]Monster Jam™ Showdown is available today[/b]!
Get ready to build your road to success and become a star in stadiums and across our environments in Alaska, Colorado, and Death Valley.
From mashing the throttle in Freestyle, to showing who’s best in adrenaline-filled Head-to-Head races, Monster Jam™ Showdown suits every taste and skill.
Drive down your path thanks to the Showdown Tour, the game’s non-linear career mode where you can choose what to do step-by-step, and get the chance to expand your garage by proving you have what it takes to drive these iconic Monster Jam™ Trucks.

[b]66 vehicles* and over 140 liveries are waiting to be collected![/b]

Whether single or multiplayer, you have plenty of challenges to keep yourselves busy: if battling the AI is not enough for you, other players will give you what you’re looking for.
For all the contenders out there, keep your engines warm: Survival mode will be available briefly after launch.

Get behind the wheel, shift into gear, and prepare for your showdown!


[i]* 40 trucks will be included in the base game and 26 will be available through free or premium DLCs[/i]

[previewyoutube=HskudFjzrYg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: How to build a Truck!
notes.notes:
Hey, Drivers! How’s it going? Is your hype for Monster Jam™ Showdown growing?
We hope so because we’re about to dig deep into the development process: specifically, we want you to have a look at how a Monster Jam™ Truck is built! We have summoned Federico Spada, Game Director, and Gianni Pacella, 3D Artist for this. We’ll let them drive you through this amazing in-depth explanation. Fasten your seat belt, get ready for an unforgettable ride, and [url=https://monsterjamvideogame.com/how-to-build-a-monster-truck/][b]read more on our website[/b][/url]!
